recipe:
Title: North African Spiced Harissa Risotto with Crispy Tofu
Total time: 35 min
Appliances: stove, blender
Ingredients:
- cooked rice: 400 g
- tofu: 200 g
- mushrooms: 150 g
- onions: 1
- garlic: 3 cloves
- cream cheese: 60 g
- harissa: 20 g
- olive oil: 30 ml
- water: 250 ml
- salt: 5 g
- pepper: 3 g
Steps:
1. Dice the tofu into small cubes and sear in a pan on the stove with half of the olive oil until crispy and golden on all sides, then remove and set aside.
2. Slice the mushrooms and saute them on the stove in the same pan until browned, then set aside with the tofu.
3. Dice the onion and mince the garlic, then cook them in the remaining olive oil on medium heat until soft and fragrant.
4. Transfer half of the cooked onion and garlic into a blender along with cream cheese, harissa, water, salt, and pepper, and puree until completely smooth.
5. Pour the blended sauce back into the pan on the stove with the remaining onions, stir in the cooked rice, and simmer gently until thick, hot, and creamy.
6. Fold in the sauteed mushrooms and top with the crispy seared tofu before serving.

recipe:
Title: Velvet Salmon and Crisp Walnut Harmony
Total time: 55 min
Appliances: slow cooker
Ingredients:
- salmon fillet: 400 g
- mushrooms: 150 g
- pumpkin: 200 g
- walnuts: 50 g
- mint: 10 g
- olive oil: 2 tbsp
- vinegar: 1 tbsp
- salt: 1 tsp
- pepper: 1/2 tsp
- water: 50 ml
Steps:
1. Thinly slice the pumpkin and mushrooms, then layer them into the bottom of the slow cooker with water, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
2. Season the salmon fillets with salt and pepper, place them atop the vegetable layer, and pour vinegar over the top.
3. Cover and cook on high heat for 45 minutes until the salmon is fully cooked through and flakes easily, while the pumpkin becomes meltingly tender.
4. Roughly chop the fresh mint and raw walnuts.
5. Gently transfer the tender salmon and softened vegetables to plates, then finish by scattering the crunchy walnuts and fresh mint over the top for a distinct textural contrast.
